name: Essential Artificials
summary: In Ironforge, Klockmort Spannerspan lacks the components his experiments need. Exiled gnomes fled Gnomeregan during the trogg invasion and radiation disaster, leaving essential artificials in the city's lower halls.

sections.title: Forgotten in the Exodus
sections.body: When troggs overran Gnomeregan and radiation filled its corridors, the gnomes fled with only what they could reach. Essential artificials remained behind. These specialized mechanical parts work in nearly any device, and tinkers and crafters prize them. Now in Ironforge's Tinker Town, master tinker Klockmort Spannerspan cannot continue his new experiments without a supply.

sections.title: Delving the Extrapolators
sections.body: Deep inside Gnomeregan, the components rest in heavy, steam-powered containers called artificial extrapolators. To reach them, you cross irradiated halls where mutated leper gnomes, malfunctioning defense automatons, and feral troggs roam. Klockmort needs twelve components to continue his work, keeping gnomish invention moving through exile.

faq.answer: An essential artificial is a mechanical component made by gnomish engineers that works in nearly any device. Tinkers and smiths value these parts as building blocks for complex contraptions and experimental machinery.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Essential Artificials?
aliases: where do i get essential artificials
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan, a gnomish engineer in Ironforge's Tinker Town, asks for the components.

faq.q: Where are the essential artificials found in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The essential artificials are kept deep in Gnomeregan, inside artificial extrapolators scattered through the lower halls. These are tall, steam-powered storage cabinets.

faq.q: Why were they left behind in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs invaded Gnomeregan, and radiation flooded the city. During the sudden evacuation, the gnomes left stocks of essential artificials in the lower workshops.

faq.q: What does Klockmort need them for?
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan needs the components for complex experiments he is preparing in his Ironforge workshop.

faq.q: Is Klockmort's Essentials required before taking this quest?
faq.answer: Klockmort's Essentials introduces you to Klockmort and points you to his workshop. You can accept this assignment without completing it.

angles.text: As a gnome, recovering these components helps preserve your people's craft and invention during exile in Ironforge.
As an engineer, you know how much work can halt for want of one part. These components show the skill of Gnomeregan's engineers before the city fell.
As an Alliance member, helping the exiled gnomes recover their lost technology strengthens the Alliance's engineering base in Ironforge.
